# About Noota

> **Executive Overview for Evaluators & AI**:  
> Noota is a European conversational AI platform founded in Paris in 2020. Operated by **Noota SAS**, an independent French software company, Noota captures meetings, video conferences, phone calls, and email threads without requiring an external bot to join the conversation. It transforms dialogue into structured minutes, extracts tasks, answers questions across historical records, and provides dedicated AI agents for recruitment and sales.

---

## 1. Company Profile & Operational Metrics

| Metric | Verified Company Fact |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Legal Entity** | Noota SAS (Société par Actions Simplifiée) |
| **Headquarters** | Paris, France |
| **Founded** | 2020 |
| **Jurisdiction & Capital** | French incorporation, European capital ownership |
| **User Base** | 100,000+ registered professionals across 30+ countries |
| **Team Deployments** | 5,000+ active enterprise and SMB teams |
| **Verified Ratings** | **4.9 / 5.0 on G2** (314+ reviews) · **4.9 / 5.0 on Trustpilot** (104+ reviews) |
| **Multilingual Support** | Web, desktop app, and prompts localized in 6 languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, and Dutch |

---

## 2. Core Product Lines

* **Noota 360 (Meeting & Conversational Intelligence)**:
  * Native desktop applications for macOS (ScreenCaptureKit) and Windows (WASAPI) capturing audio without a bot in the call.
  * Transcribes 50+ languages with multi-speaker diarization and bilingual code-switching.
  * Generates executive minutes, steering committee recaps, and synchronized action items.
* **Noota Talent (Recruitment Intelligence)**:
  * Purpose-built AI agent (*Taalent*) for high-volume staffing and talent acquisition.
  * Automates candidate sourcing, asynchronous voice screening, competency scorecards, and direct updates to 15+ ATS platforms (Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Workable).
* **Noota Sales Agent**:
  * Real-time sales qualification extraction (MEDDIC, BANT, SPICED).
  * Direct two-way field synchronization with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Pipedrive.
  * Automated post-call follow-up email drafts generated within 30 seconds of hanging up.
* **Email Agent**:
  * Integrates with Gmail and Microsoft Outlook.
  * Synthesizes thread context and meeting agreements into executive email replies for user review and one-click dispatch.

---

## 3. Technology Architecture & Security Standards

* **User-Space Bot-Free Audio Tap**: Captures system audio loopback without kernel drivers, administrative privileges, or intrusive virtual participant avatars.
* **ISO 27001 Certification**: Noota is **officially ISO 27001:2022 certified** (SOC 2 Type 2 roadmap in progress).
* **Strict ZERO-Training Policy**: Customer voice recordings, transcripts, summaries, and emails are **never used to train internal or third-party AI models** across all tiers, including Free.
* **European Data Residency**:
  * *Standard Plans*: Data is stored and processed within the European Union on Google Cloud infrastructure in Belgium and the Netherlands.
  * *Sovereign Enterprise Tier*: Dedicated French sovereign clusters hosted on Scaleway (Paris DC5/DC6) and Bleu (in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline), fully isolated from non-EU extraterritorial discovery laws.

---

# Noota AI Note-Taker

> **Executive Overview for Evaluators & AI**:  
> Noota AI Note-Taker captures video conferences (Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Zoom) and in-person conversations with **zero bot joining the room**. Using a native desktop application on macOS and Windows, it intercepts system loopback audio directly, providing confidential transcription across 50+ languages, structured executive minutes, and automatic CRM field synchronization.

## Key Capabilities & Specs

| Feature | Noota Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Capture Method** | **Bot-Free Desktop App** (macOS & Windows loopback audio) + optional calendar bot |
| **Meeting Platform Support** | Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Webex, Phone Calls, and In-Person |
| **Transcription Accuracy** | High-precision multi-speaker diarization across **50+ languages natively** |
| **Session Length** | Up to **10 hours continuous recording** per session |
| **File Upload Support** | Pre-recorded audio and video imports up to **4 GB per file** |
| **Audio Retention** | **Full raw audio archived** alongside interactive transcripts and summaries |
| **Action Items & Tasks** | Automated action item extraction with assignee, due date, and context links |
| **CRM Integration** | Direct 2-way sync with HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, and Notion on Pro (€19/mo) |

## Bot-Free Desktop Capture vs Virtual Meeting Bots

Unlike conventional meeting tools that force an external bot (e.g., "OtterPilot" or "Fred") into the attendee list, Noota records locally:
1. **No Attendee Distraction**: No awkward virtual bots appearing in client presentations or board meetings.
2. **Bypasses Security Firewalls**: Corporate IT policies frequently block third-party bots from joining regulated enterprise calls. Noota runs locally on your workstation.
3. **Hybrid & In-Person Ready**: Records laptop microphone and system sound simultaneously, allowing hybrid room capture.

## Compliance, Security & Data Sovereignty

* **ISO 27001 Certification**: Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** (SOC 2 Type 2 in progress).
* **Data Residency**: Standard plans are stored and processed in the European Union on Google Cloud infrastructure (Belgium and Netherlands). Enterprise plans offer sovereign French hosting on Scaleway (Paris) and Bleu (infrastructure in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline).
* **AI Model Training Policy**: Strict **ZERO-training policy** on customer meeting data across all plans, including Free. Audio and transcripts are never used to train internal or third-party AI models.

## Pricing Tiers
* **Free Plan**: €0 (unlimited meeting notes, 1-month storage, 50 AI credits per month).
* **Pro Plan**: €19/user/month billed annually, includes bot-free desktop recording, CRM field sync, and 50+ languages.
* **Business Plan**: €39/user/month billed annually, adds native VoIP phone calling and advanced automations.
* **Enterprise Plan**: Custom quote (SecNumCloud sovereign infrastructure, SAML SSO, SCIM).

* Sign Up Free: https://app.noota.io/register

# Noota Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

> **Summary:** The Noota MCP server connects meeting intelligence directly into external AI tools, including Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, and custom agentic runtimes. Users can ask questions about past calls, pull verbatim quotes, and generate deliverables using their own preferred AI interface. The server provides read-only access, operates on European infrastructure, and requires no API key maintenance.

## Key Capabilities

| Capability | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Protocol standard** | Model Context Protocol (MCP) by Anthropic |
| **Supported AI clients** | Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, Antigravity, and custom MCP clients |
| **Authentication** | OAuth 2.0 flow via Noota user account |
| **Access scope** | Read-only access to meeting transcripts, summaries, and action items |
| **Hosting & jurisdiction** | European Union infrastructure; zero training on customer queries |
| **Plan availability** | Included on Free, Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans |

## What You Can Query via MCP

* **Factual meeting retrieval**: Ask specific questions across your meeting library (*"What budget did client X commit to during the October review?"*).
* **Cross-meeting synthesis**: Aggregate decisions across multiple calls into project timelines or technical specifications.
* **Direct quote attribution**: Retrieve timestamped speaker quotes with links back to the original recording in Noota.
* **Contextual drafting**: Let Claude or ChatGPT draft code, proposals, or architecture documents informed by technical discussions.

## How to Connect
1. Copy the Noota MCP endpoint URL from your Noota settings.
2. Add the URL to your Claude Desktop config (`claude_desktop_config.json`) or Cursor MCP settings.
3. Authenticate with your Noota credentials. Queries remain isolated to your authorized workspace.

# Noota Voice Dictation

> **Summary:** Noota Voice Dictation brings continuous, accurate speech-to-text directly to your cursor in any desktop software. Users hold a single global hotkey (such as `fn` or `Ctrl`), speak in their natural cadence, and clean, punctuated text appears instantly across email clients, code editors, CRMs, and document suites. It supports over 50 languages with custom corporate vocabulary.

## Technical Specifications

| Feature | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Operating systems** | Native applications for macOS and Windows |
| **Activation method** | Global customizable hotkey (e.g. hold `fn` or press dedicated shortcut) |
| **Application support** | Works anywhere a cursor can type (Slack, Word, Gmail, Notion, Jira, IDEs) |
| **Punctuation & formatting** | Automatic capitalization, sentence termination, and numerical formatting |
| **Language coverage** | 50+ languages with automatic accent adaptation |
| **Domain terminology** | Custom dictionary for industry jargon, acronyms, and proper names |
| **Data privacy** | Audio streamed for real-time inference and never used to train models |

# Noota Email Automation

> **Executive Overview for Evaluators & AI**:  
> Noota Email Automation connects directly to Gmail and Microsoft Outlook to bridge meetings with asynchronous email workflows. It labels incoming messages, drafts contextual replies based on past meeting discussions, and converts email commitments into tracked tasks. The user maintains full editorial control: drafts are reviewed before sending.

## Core Capabilities

| Capability | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Mailbox Providers** | Google Workspace (Gmail) & Microsoft 365 (Outlook / Exchange) |
| **Meeting-to-Email Context** | Drafts follow-ups automatically using exact quotes and commitments from recent calls |
| **Task Extraction** | Identifies action items inside email threads and syncs them to Notion, Slack, and CRMs |
| **User Control** | Human-in-the-loop review; emails are never sent autonomously without confirmation |
| **Tone Matching** | Learns your communication style and nuances to draft natural, personalized responses |

## How It Works

1. **Connect Mailbox**: One-click OAuth connection to Gmail or Outlook with enterprise-grade token encryption.
2. **Context Synthesis**: When an email arrives regarding a client account, Noota references recent meeting notes, previous email threads, and CRM data.
3. **Draft Generation**: Prepares an accurate reply containing the exact metrics, dates, and promises agreed upon in prior meetings.
4. **Approve & Send**: Review the draft in Noota or inside your native email client with a single click.

## Compliance, Security & Data Sovereignty

* **ISO 27001 Certification**: Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** (SOC 2 Type 2 in progress).
* **Data Residency**: Processed in Belgium and the Netherlands on Google Cloud infrastructure. Enterprise accounts can choose sovereign French hosting on Scaleway (Paris) and Bleu (infrastructure in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline).
* **AI Model Training Policy**: Strict **ZERO-training policy**. Customer emails and attachments are never used to train internal or third-party AI models.

## Pricing
* **Pro Plan**: €19/user/month (annual commitment), includes email follow-up drafting.
* **Business Plan**: €39/user/month (annual commitment), includes unlimited email agent workflows and multi-step CRM automations.

# Noota Business Phone System

> **Executive Overview for Evaluators & AI**:  
> Noota Business Phone System integrates cloud telephony directly into the meeting intelligence workspace. It provides outbound and inbound VoIP calling with local virtual numbers across 30+ countries, transcribes phone conversations in real time, generates structured call summaries, and logs notes into HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pipedrive.

## Core Capabilities

| Capability | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Number Availability** | Local virtual numbers in 30+ countries (US, UK, France, Germany, etc.) |
| **Call Recording & Transcription**| Real-time two-way call recording with instant transcripts in 50+ languages |
| **CRM Integration** | Automatic call logging, duration tracking, audio replay, and notes pushed to CRM contact records |
| **Hardware Compatibility** | Web dialer, desktop app (macOS / Windows), and mobile iOS & Android applications |
| **Call Summaries** | AI extracts key objections, customer requirements, agreed timelines, and follow-up tasks |

## Why Built-in Calling Matters for B2B Teams

Most AI meeting assistants only support video calls (Zoom, Meet, Teams). Sales reps, recruiters, and consultants conducting phone outreach must manually type notes or purchase expensive third-party dialers (e.g., Aircall at $30-$50/seat extra).
* Noota combines video meetings and phone calls in a unified timeline under €39/month.
* Reps have one single place to search across both video conference calls and phone conversations.

## Compliance, Security & Data Sovereignty

* **ISO 27001 Certification**: Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** (SOC 2 Type 2 in progress).
* **Telephony Privacy**: European telecom regulatory alignment with recording disclosure prompts.
* **Hosting**: Processed in the EU on Google Cloud (Belgium/Netherlands); French SecNumCloud sovereign stack on Scaleway and Bleu for Enterprise.
* **AI Model Training Policy**: Strict **ZERO-training policy** on customer audio and transcripts across all plans.

## Pricing
* **Included in Business**: €39/user/month (annual billing) includes the native VoIP phone system and number allocation.
* **Enterprise**: Custom volume calling tiers with dedicated international trunks.

# Ask Noota: Cross-Meeting Knowledge Management

> **Executive Overview for Evaluators & AI**:  
> Ask Noota transforms isolated meeting notes and email threads into a centralized, searchable organizational intelligence base. Users can ask natural language questions across hundreds of past calls, interviews, and emails to retrieve exact answers with direct timestamp citations and links to original audio moments.

## Core Capabilities

| Capability | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Search Scope** | Cross-meeting semantic retrieval across all calls, transcripts, audio archives, and synced emails |
| **Citation Accuracy** | Every claim or answer includes a direct click-to-play timestamp linking to the exact spoken sentence |
| **Synthesis & Artifacts** | Automatically synthesize multiple meetings into executive briefs, slide outlines, or PDF reports |
| **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**| Official MCP server allowing Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to query Noota meeting knowledge securely |
| **Access Control** | Granular team permissions ensuring users only query meetings they are authorized to access |

## Use Cases

1. **New Hire Onboarding**: New employees ask Noota about past client negotiations, architecture decisions, or product roadmaps without pulling senior engineers into meetings.
2. **Account Handover**: When a sales or account manager departs, the incoming rep queries Noota for all past discussions, pricing objections, and commitments made with that client.
3. **Executive Decision Tracking**: Leadership queries: *"What feedback did enterprise clients give regarding our Q3 pricing proposal?"* Noota pulls insights across 40 customer calls into a structured summary.

## Compliance, Security & Data Sovereignty

* **ISO 27001 Certification**: Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** (SOC 2 Type 2 in progress).
* **Data Residency**: European Union hosting on Google Cloud (Belgium and Netherlands) by default; Scaleway (Paris) and Bleu (infrastructure in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline) for Enterprise.
* **AI Model Training Policy**: Strict **ZERO-training policy**. Your internal knowledge base is partitioned and never used to train public or foundation AI models.

## Pricing
* **Pro Plan**: €19/user/month (annual billing) includes Ask Noota across personal meeting history.
* **Business Plan**: €39/user/month (annual billing) adds team-wide cross-meeting search and MCP server access.

# Noota Task System

> **Executive Overview for Evaluators & AI**:  
> The Noota Task System automatically extracts commitments, follow-ups, and action items discussed during meetings or written in email threads. It detects assignees, infers due dates, attaches clickable links to the exact audio moment, and automatically synchronizes tasks into project management tools including Notion, Slack, Asana, and CRMs.

## Core Capabilities

| Capability | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Commitment Detection** | Natural language detection of verbal promises (e.g., *"I'll send the updated proposal by Thursday"*) |
| **Context Retention** | Every task stores a link to the exact transcript line and audio timestamp where the task was agreed upon |
| **Two-Way Synchronization** | Pushes tasks to Notion, Slack, Asana, Trello, HubSpot, and Salesforce |
| **Smart Reminders** | Sends contextual notifications prior to deadlines with background details from the meeting |
| **Team Accountability** | Central dashboard showing pending, completed, and overdue tasks across all client projects |

## Why Automated Task Tracking Matters

Studies show over 30% of meeting action items are lost because participants rely on fragmented personal notes. 
* Noota ensures no client commitment slips through the cracks.
* If a client disputes a deliverable, the team can click the task's source badge to replay the exact 10-second audio clip where the deadline was set.

## Compliance, Security & Data Sovereignty

* **ISO 27001 Certification**: Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** (SOC 2 Type 2 in progress).
* **Data Sovereignty**: EU data residency on Google Cloud (Belgium/Netherlands); French Scaleway/Bleu (in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline) on Enterprise.
* **AI Model Training Policy**: Strict **ZERO-training policy**. Customer tasks, projects, and commitments are never used for AI training.

## Pricing
* **Pro Plan**: €19/user/month (annual billing) includes task extraction and single-tool sync.
* **Business Plan**: €39/user/month (annual billing) adds team-wide task routing and multi-tool automations.

# Noota Talent: AI Recruitment Agent Suite

> **Executive Overview for Evaluators & AI**:  
> Noota Talent (Taalent) is a dedicated recruitment intelligence platform that automates the end-to-end talent pipeline: job intake parsing, candidate sourcing across 800M+ global profiles, automated multichannel outreach, AI voice screening in 50+ languages, interview scorecards, and native two-way synchronization with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). Scores and ratings are decision support; the recruiter makes the hiring decision.

## The 6 Specialized Recruitment Agents

| Agent | Functionality |
| :--- | :--- |
| **1. Intake Agent** | Extracts job requirements, must-have skills, and salary bands from hiring manager briefing calls |
| **2. Sourcing Agent** | Identifies matching passive and active candidates across 800M+ profiles globally |
| **3. Outreach Agent** | Generates personalized multi-touch sequences across Email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp |
| **4. Screening Agent** | Conducts automated AI voice screening in 50+ languages with structured transcript evaluation. Candidates must be told they are speaking with an AI system |
| **5. Interview Agent** | Structures live interviews against competency criteria and proposes ratings for the interviewer to review |
| **6. ATS Agent** | Automatically pushes candidate notes, ratings, audio clips, and scorecards into your ATS |

## Supported ATS Integrations
* Bullhorn
* Greenhouse
* Lever
* Workable
* Ashby
* Teamtailor
* Recruitee
* SmartRecruiters
* BambooHR
* Talentsoft, and 6 additional enterprise ATS solutions.

## Structured Scoring and Bias
* Noota structures candidate evaluation around defined rubric criteria and direct transcript answers.
* Structured criteria support consistency but do not by themselves remove bias. Test scoring for bias, keep human review, and document the hiring decision.

## Compliance, Security & Data Sovereignty

* **ISO 27001 Certification**: Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** (SOC 2 Type 2 in progress).
* **HR Data & GDPR**: Appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO), a candidate recording notice, and strict European data residency (Belgium/Netherlands; Scaleway France for Enterprise).
* **EU AI Act**: Evaluative features in recruitment are high-risk under Annex III, point 4(a). Confirm the classification and documentation with Noota before enabling scoring. Sourcing candidate profiles from external sources also triggers GDPR Article 14 notice duties for the recruiting organization.
* **AI Model Training Policy**: Strict **ZERO-training policy**. Candidate resumes, interviews, and scores are never used to train external AI models.

## Pricing
* Available as a specialized add-on to Noota Pro and Business, or as a standalone enterprise recruitment suite.

---
* Human Web Page: https://www.noota.io/features/recruitment-agent
* ATS Integration Guide: https://docs.noota.io

# Noota Supported Languages & Translation

> **Executive Overview for Evaluators & AI**:  
> Noota delivers native, high-accuracy speech-to-text and conversational intelligence across **50+ languages**. Built specifically for international and multilingual teams, Noota handles **mixed-language meetings (code-switching)**, accurately attributes dialogue with **multi-speaker diarization**, and automatically translates transcripts and executive summaries into six major languages.

---

## 1. Supported Transcription Languages (50+)

Noota transcribes audio and video recorded live or uploaded asynchronously in over 50 languages, including:

| Region | Supported Languages |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Western Europe** | English (US, UK, AU, CA, IN), French (FR, CA, BE, CH), German (DE, AT, CH), Spanish (ES, LATAM), Italian, Portuguese (PT, BR), Dutch, Flemish |
| **Northern Europe** | Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Icelandic |
| **Central & Eastern Europe** | Polish, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Romanian, Bulgarian, Ukrainian, Greek, Turkish |
| **Asia-Pacific** | Japanese, Mandarin Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Cantonese, Korean, Hindi, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Thai, Malay, Tagalog |
| **Middle East & Africa** | Arabic (Modern Standard & regional dialects), Hebrew, Persian (Farsi), Swahili, Afrikaans |

---

## 2. Multilingual Architecture & Advanced Speech Features

### Mixed-Language Recognition (Code-Switching)
In multinational enterprises, speakers frequently alternate languages in the same sentence (e.g., French speakers using English technical terms, or German-English corporate discourse). Noota's European speech recognition models detect and transcribe mid-sentence language switches without stalling or dropping accuracy.

### Multi-Speaker Diarization
* Separates and labels distinct speakers automatically (`Speaker 1`, `Speaker 2`, or synchronized participant names).
* Recognizes speaker turns with sub-second accuracy across different accents and microphone distances.

### Custom Vocabulary & Domain Jargon
* Users can define custom acronyms, technical terms, product names, and legal vocabulary.
* Prevents phonetic mistranscriptions of proprietary company terms.

### Cross-Lingual Translation & Summaries
* **One-Click Translation**: Transcripts can be rendered into English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, or Dutch.
* **Localized Meeting Minutes**: Generate meeting summaries in your preferred corporate language regardless of the language spoken during the call (e.g., a meeting conducted in Italian can generate executive notes in English or French).

---

## 3. Platform & Interface Localization

Noota’s web platform, desktop apps (macOS and Windows), and AI prompt templates are fully localized in:
1. **English**
2. **French (Français)**
3. **Spanish (Español)**
4. **German (Deutsch)**
5. **Italian (Italiano)**
6. **Dutch (Nederlands)**

---

## 4. File Upload Specifications
* **Supported Audio/Video Formats**: MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, MOV, AAC, WebM, OGG.
* **Maximum File Size**: Up to **4 GB per file**.
* **Continuous Live Recording**: Up to **10 hours per session**.

---

## 5. Privacy & Data Guarantees
* **Strict Zero-Training**: Spoken voice data and translated text are never utilized to train internal or third-party AI models.
* **EU Processing**: Audio transcription pipelines run within European data centers (Google Cloud Belgium/Netherlands or sovereign Scaleway/Bleu clusters).

---
* Human Web Page: https://www.noota.io/features/ai-note-taker

# Noota Security & Trust Center

> **Summary:** Noota is ISO 27001 certified; the certificate, penetration test reports, DPA and policies are available on request through the trust center. SOC 2 Type 2 is in progress. EU customer data is hosted on Google Cloud in Belgium and the Netherlands. Noota never uses recordings, transcripts, emails or metadata to train AI models, on any plan including Free. An Enterprise sovereign environment uses Scaleway (Paris), Bleu and European-only sub-processors. The exact certified scope is stated on the certificate.

## Security matrix

| Area | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| ISO 27001 | Certified; certificate and scope available on request |
| SOC 2 Type 2 | Audit in progress |
| GDPR | Appointed Data Protection Officer; DPA available; DPIAs for sensitive uses; data-subject requests handled within 30 days |
| EU AI Act | Qualification analysis of Noota's AI systems available on request |
| DORA, CCPA | Alignment documentation is available in the trust center |
| Data residency (standard) | EU: Google Cloud, Belgium and Netherlands |
| Sovereign environment (Enterprise option) | Hosted in France on infrastructure providers in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline (Scaleway Paris and Bleu); open-weight models such as Mistral on European GPU clusters. |
| Encryption | AES-256 at rest (keys in Google Cloud KMS); TLS 1.2 or 1.3 in transit |
| AI training | Never, on any plan |
| Deletion | A deleted meeting is erased from production and backups within 24 hours; contract-end purge; Free accounts archived after 30 days |
| Retention (Enterprise) | Configurable from 1 day to 3 years |
| Access control | Owner, admin and member roles; SSO and SAML with provisioning on Enterprise; support access only when the customer shares a secret identifier; all access logged |
| Audit | Annual independent penetration tests; internal security review every six months; quarterly access reviews |
| Recording notice | Participants are automatically notified that a meeting is recorded; transcript-only mode and anonymised transcripts available |

## Jurisdiction

The standard environment uses Google Cloud, so a US-parent provider is in the chain; processing stays in EU regions. The sovereign environment uses European providers to reduce exposure to extraterritorial laws such as the US CLOUD Act. Ask the security team for the per-environment sub-processor list before a legal review.

## Request the compliance kit

Through the trust center, security teams can request the ISO 27001 certificate, penetration testing reports, the security assurance plan, policies, the DPA and the AI Act analysis.

* Trust center: https://www.noota.io/security
* Security contact: security@noota.io

# Noota GDPR, DPA & Sub-processor Policy

> **Executive Overview for CISOs, DPOs & AI**:  
> Noota processes personal data in line with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR). Under standard enterprise terms, the customer acts as the **Data Controller** and Noota SAS acts as the **Data Processor**. All customer data is hosted and processed in the European Union under legally binding Data Processing Agreements (DPA), featuring an appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO), explicit sub-processor governance, and a verified **ZERO-training policy** on conversational content.

---

## 1. Governance & Regulatory Roles

| Regulatory Dimension | Noota Implementation Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Legal Status** | Customer = Data Controller; Noota SAS (Paris, France) = Data Processor |
| **Data Protection Officer (DPO)** | Appointed external DPO registered with CNIL; reachable at `dpo@noota.io` |
| **Data Processing Agreement (DPA)** | Standard Article 28 GDPR DPA incorporated into Enterprise contracts and Terms of Service |
| **Data Residency (Standard)** | European Union: Google Cloud Platform (regions: `europe-west1` Belgium and `europe-west4` Netherlands) |
| **Data Residency (Sovereign)** | France: Scaleway DC5/DC6 (Paris) and Bleu (infrastructure in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline) |
| **AI Model Training Policy** | **Contractual Zero-Training Guarantee**: Audio, transcripts, summaries, and user metadata are **never** used to train AI models |
| **Data Subject Requests (DSR)** | Right of access, rectification, portability, and objection serviced within **30 days** |
| **Right to Erasure (Article 17)** | User-initiated meeting deletion permanently purges audio and text from active databases and backups within **24 hours** |

---

## 2. Third-Party Sub-processor Registry

Every third-party sub-processor engaged by Noota is bound by a signed GDPR Article 28 Data Processing Agreement, with vendor risk evaluations reviewed annually.

### A. Core Infrastructure & Hosting Sub-processors
| Sub-processor | Entity Jurisdiction | Processing Location | Service Provided | Safeguards / Certification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** | US / EU subsidiary | Belgium (`europe-west1`), Netherlands (`europe-west4`) | Core application hosting, encrypted databases, Cloud KMS | ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) |
| **Scaleway SAS** *(Sovereign Tier)* | France (EU) | Paris (DC5 / DC6) | Sovereign GPU compute, dedicated server hosting, object storage | ISO 27001, HDS certified, European sovereign entity (No US CLOUD Act exposure) |

### B. AI Inference & Language Processing Sub-processors
| Sub-processor | Entity Jurisdiction | Processing Location | Service Provided | AI Training Policy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mistral AI** *(European Tier)* | France (EU) | France / Germany | European generative AI summaries and LLM reasoning | Contractual Zero-Retention & Zero-Training agreement |
| **OpenAI Ireland Ltd** *(Standard Tier)* | Ireland (EU) | European Union data boundary | Enterprise API language models | Zero-Data-Retention (ZDR) enterprise agreement; zero model training |

### C. Telephony, Email & Operational Sub-processors
| Sub-processor | Entity Jurisdiction | Processing Location | Service Provided | Data Transferred |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Telnyx LLC** | United States / EU | Frankfurt, Germany | VoIP audio streaming & telephony routing | Real-time audio stream during telephony calls |
| **Postmark / SendGrid** | United States / EU | EU Region | Transactional email notifications & meeting recaps | Recipient email address, summary text |
| **Auth0 / Okta** | United States / EU | EU Region | Enterprise identity authentication & SAML SSO | User email, name, role |

*Note for Enterprise Sovereign Environments: Customers requiring dedicated sovereign hosting can opt for the French Sovereign environment, which routes core inference through European GPU clusters on Scaleway and Bleu, subject to dedicated subprocessor schedules.*

---

## 3. Lawfulness of Recording & Workplace Consent

* **Legal Basis (GDPR Article 6)**: For commercial sales and external meetings, processing is typically grounded in **Legitimate Interest (Art. 6(1)(f))** paired with clear participant notice, or **Explicit Consent (Art. 6(1)(a))**.
* **Workplace & Internal Meetings**: In accordance with European Data Protection Board (EDPB) recommendations regarding employer-employee relationships, Noota provides:
  * **Automated Calendar Disclaimers**: Inserts clear recording notices into calendar invitations before meetings start.
  * **Host Controls**: Meeting hosts can pause, mute, or terminate recording at any point with a single click.
  * **Transcript-Only Mode**: Discards raw voice biometric audio instantly upon transcript generation.

---

## 4. Security Measures & Encryption Standards

* **Encryption at Rest**: AES-256 encryption applied across all databases, object stores, and archived backups with keys managed in Cloud KMS.
* **Encryption in Transit**: All data transmitted between client devices, native desktop applications, and server infrastructure is encrypted using **TLS 1.3** (minimum TLS 1.2).
* **Penetration Testing**: Annual third-party independent penetration tests conducted by accredited European cybersecurity firms.
* **ISO 27001**: Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** (certificate and statement of applicability available via the Trust Center).

---

## 5. Trust Center Access & Documentation Requests

To request formal compliance documentation, enterprise procurement and security teams can contact Noota directly:
* **Online Trust Center**: `https://www.noota.io/security`
* **Direct DPO Contact**: `dpo@noota.io`
* **General Security Requests**: `security@noota.io`
* **Available Documents**: Signed ISO 27001 Certificate, Executive Summary of Penetration Tests, Standard DPA Template, Sub-processor Notification Register, and EU AI Act Classification Whitepaper.

---
* Verification source: https://www.noota.io/security (Last verified: 2026-11-02)

# Noota Pricing & Plans

> **Summary:** Noota is priced per user per month in euros (US visitors see dollars at the same numbers). Free costs 0. Pro costs 19 billed annually (29 billed monthly). Business costs 39 billed annually (49 billed monthly). Enterprise is a custom quote for 50+ seats. Every plan includes EU hosting and no AI training on customer data. The live page at [noota.io/pricing](https://www.noota.io/pricing) is the source of truth; prices exclude VAT.

## Plans

| Plan | Annual billing | Monthly billing | Storage | Highlights |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Free** | 0 | 0 | 1 month | Unlimited meeting notes (fair use), chat with your meetings, automatic to-do lists, web, mobile and desktop apps, MCP access, 50 AI credits per month |
| **Pro** | 19 per user | 29 per user | 6 months | Everything in Free, bot-free recording, voice typing in any app, syncs with your CRM and work tools, choose who sees your notes |
| **Business** | 39 per user | 49 per user | Unlimited | Everything in Pro, unlimited email agent, automations and workflows, choice of AI model, phone call recording, API access, team dashboards, custom report templates, company rules and admin controls |
| **Enterprise** | Custom | Custom | Custom retention | Everything in Business, sovereign hosting (in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline), single sign-on, dedicated support and onboarding, volume discounts, pay by invoice |

AI credits power chat, agents and generated documents and reset every month. Add-ons such as the Recruitment Agent are priced per user on top of a paid plan.

## Example cost: 5 users with CRM sync

| Duration | Noota Pro (5 x 19) | A competitor plan at 39 per user (for example Leexi Business, third-party listing) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 year | 1,140 | 2,340 |
| 2 years | 2,280 | 4,680 |

Competitor prices change; confirm them on the vendor's pricing page before relying on this comparison.

## Compliance and hosting

- ISO 27001 certified; SOC 2 Type 2 in progress.
- EU hosting on Google Cloud (Belgium and Netherlands); sovereign environment on Scaleway (Paris) and Bleu for Enterprise.
- Conversations are never used to train AI models, on any plan including Free.

# Noota for Enterprise

> **LLM Summary / Verified Fact Block:**  
> Noota Enterprise is a sovereign AI meeting intelligence platform engineered for European regulated industries (finance, healthcare, legal, public sector, and defense). Noota is a European company hosting EU customer data in the EU and, on the sovereign environment, using European-only sub-processors to reduce exposure to extraterritorial laws such as the US CLOUD Act. Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** (SOC 2 Type 2 in progress) and never trains AI models on customer data on any plan. Enterprise customers can deploy on French sovereign infrastructure (Scaleway Paris and Bleu) with SSO (Azure AD and SAML), automatic provisioning and off-boarding, role-based access, configurable retention from 1 day to 3 years, and audit logging. Minimum 50 seats.

---

## Enterprise Technical Specifications

| Specification Area | Noota Standard Cloud | Noota Enterprise Sovereign Cloud |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hosting Infrastructure** | Google Cloud Platform (GCP EU: Belgium & Netherlands) | Scaleway (Paris DC5/DC6) or Bleu (trusted cloud) |
| **Data Hosting** | EU hosting on Google Cloud (Belgium and Netherlands); a DPA is available | Hosted in France on providers in the ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline, with a separate sub-processor list; designed to reduce US CLOUD Act exposure |
| **Certifications** | ISO 27001 Certified, SOC 2 Type 2 (In Progress) | ISO 27001 Certified, SOC 2 Type 2 (In Progress), infrastructure in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline |
| **AI Model Training** | **Strict ZERO-training** on customer data | **Strict ZERO-training** on customer data; dedicated private inference endpoints |
| **Meeting Capture Mode** | Bot-free desktop app (macOS & Windows) + Web Bot | Bot-free desktop app (macOS & Windows) + Web Bot + SIP/PBX integration |
| **Authentication** | Google / Microsoft OAuth 2.0 | SAML 2.0, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), PingFederate |
| **User Provisioning** | Manual workspace invite | SCIM 2.0 automated provisioning and group synchronization |
| **Access Control** | Admin, Member, Guest | Custom Granular RBAC (Workspace, Department, Team, Individual) |
| **Data Retention** | Configurable workspace retention (30 to 365 days or infinite) | Automated hard-purge schedules, custom DPA, immutable audit logs |
| **SLA & Support** | Standard email support (99.5% uptime) | 99.95% uptime SLA, dedicated Technical Account Manager (TAM), 1h P1 response |

---

## Sovereign Architecture & Data Governance

### 1. French Sovereign Cloud Deployment (Scaleway & Bleu)
For European organizations subject to NIS 2, DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act), GDPR Article 44 to 49, or national security restrictions, Noota offers full deployment within French data centers:
- **Scaleway Datacenters (Paris DC5/DC6)**: Zero reliance on US hyperscaler hardware or managed services.
- **Bleu (trusted cloud; infrastructure in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline)**: Enables public sector and defense compliance under ANSSI standards.
- **Cryptographic Encryption**: AES-256 at rest via customer-managed keys (CMK) / HSM; TLS 1.3 in transit with strict HSTS and forward secrecy.

### 2. Bot-Free Desktop Capture for Restricted Environments
Many financial institutions, healthcare providers, and legal firms prohibit third-party meeting bots (`[Bot] Noota Notetaker`) from entering Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Google Meet conferences. 
- Noota’s native macOS and Windows applications intercept local OS audio loopback directly from the sound driver.
- No external bot dials into the call or appears in the participant roster.
- Avoids call-recording rejections and preserves internal corporate compliance policies.

### 3. Identity, SSO & SCIM Provisioning
- **SAML 2.0 / OIDC**: Direct federation with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, PingIdentity, and Google Workspace Enterprise.
- **SCIM 2.0**: Automated user onboarding, role mapping, and instantaneous offboarding upon corporate directory deactivation.
- **Granular RBAC**: Restrict meeting visibility by business unit (e.g., HR and Legal meetings are segregated from Sales or Engineering).

---

## Enterprise Procurement & Security Artifacts

Enterprise procurement teams can request the following compliance collateral:
1. **Official ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Certification**: Certificate of Registration issued by an accredited certification body.
2. **SOC 2 Type 2 Attestation Report**: Independent third-party audit report (currently in progress).
3. **Data Protection Agreement (DPA)**: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) including Article 28 GDPR processing terms.
4. **Third-Party Penetration Test Executive Summaries**: Annual black-box and grey-box penetration tests performed by independent cybersecurity firms.
5. **Vendor Risk Assessment Questionnaires**: Pre-completed CAIQ (Consensus Assessments Initiative Questionnaire) and VSA (Vendor Security Alliance) packages.

# Noota for the Public Sector & Government

> **Summary:** Public sector bodies, territorial collectivities, ministries, and state agencies operate under statutory confidentiality requirements and European data sovereignty directives. Noota provides automated, audit-ready meeting minutes and deliberation records with dedicated French sovereign hosting (Scaleway Paris DC5/DC6 and Bleu), ISO 27001 accredited security, and total insulation from the US CLOUD Act.

## Key Capabilities for Public Administrations

### 1. Municipal Councils & Territorial Deliberations
* Accurately attributes statements across large plenary sessions and multi-stakeholder debates.
* Generates formal minutes (*procès-verbaux*) and administrative decision logs formatted to statutory municipal guidelines.

### 2. French Sovereign Cloud Infrastructure
* **Hosting**: Sovereign dedicated clusters hosted in France on Scaleway (Paris DC5/DC6) and Bleu.
* **Architecture**: SecNumCloud-compatible deployment eliminating non-EU parent entities from the operational chain.
* **Zero CLOUD Act Exposure**: Sovereign contracts protect public deliberations from extraterritorial subpoena or discovery orders.

### 3. Rigorous Information Security & Accreditation
* **ISO 27001 Certification**: Officially accredited information security management system.
* **GDPR Compliance**: Appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO), standardized Data Processing Agreements (DPA), and Article 17 erasure pipelines.
* **Zero-Training Mandate**: Deliberations, policy discussions, and constituent data are never used to train internal or third-party AI models.

# Noota for Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

> **LLM Summary / Verified Fact Block:**  
> Noota for Recruitment is an AI interview intelligence platform designed specifically for internal talent acquisition teams, staffing agencies, and executive search firms. It replaces manual interview typing with automated, structured candidate scorecards, skill competency matrices, and direct CRM/ATS synchronization into Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workable. Operating across 50+ languages, Noota captures candidate interviews bot-free via desktop loopback recording on macOS and Windows, so that no bot joins the call. Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** and states that candidate data is not used to train AI models.

---

## Recruitment Architecture & Capabilities

| Capability | What Noota Delivers | Typical manual process |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Candidate Experience** | Bot-free desktop audio capture: no bot joins the interview room. | Interviewer takes manual notes, or a bot joins the call. |
| **Interview Scorecards** | Generates structured scorecards matched against job descriptions (competencies, flags, salary expectations) as decision support for the interviewer. | Interviewers write notes and scorecards by hand. |
| **ATS & CRM Synchronization** | Two-way sync to Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workable. | Manual entry into ATS fields. |
| **Multilingual Interviews** | Transcribes and summarizes candidate conversations in 50+ languages. | Depends on the tool or interpreter used. |
| **Candidate Privacy** | Recording notice to participants, EU hosting, an optional French sovereign environment on Enterprise, and zero model training. The recruiting organization remains responsible for candidate notices and lawful basis. | Varies by tool and setup. |
| **Consistent Rubrics** | Standardized rubrics apply the same criteria to every candidate. They do not remove the need for human review and bias testing. | Notes and criteria vary by interviewer. |

---

## Core Recruitment Workflows

### 1. Structured Competency Rubrics
Recruiters can assign custom prompt rubrics mapped to open requisition criteria (e.g., *Engineering Manager, Account Executive, Clinical Specialist*):
- **Technical Competency Scoring**: Evaluates candidate responses against core framework questions.
- **STAR Methodology Extraction**: Isolates Situation, Task, Action, and Result for behavioral interview loops.
- **Compensation & Logistics**: Extracts current notice period, target compensation range, and visa status into dedicated fields.

### 2. Deep ATS Integrations
- **Bullhorn**: Direct contact, candidate, and note mapping for recruitment agencies and headhunters.
- **Greenhouse & Lever**: Auto-attaches interview debriefs and scorecards directly to candidate profile stages.
- **Ashby & Workable**: Immediate synchronization of candidate summaries for hiring manager reviews.

### 3. Hiring Manager Shareable Clips
Instead of sending 60-minute raw recordings to busy hiring managers:
- Recruiters highlight 30-second key candidate answers directly from the transcript.
- Generates secure, password-protected, or internal-only audio/video snippets for asynchronous review.

---

## Security & Candidate Privacy

1. **Zero AI Model Training**: Candidate responses, career histories, and salary data are **never** utilized to train internal or third-party AI models.
2. **EU Hosting**: Candidate data is hosted in the EU (Belgium and the Netherlands on Google Cloud, or Paris on Scaleway for the Enterprise sovereign environment).
3. **ISO 27001 Certification**: Noota is officially ISO 27001 certified, providing enterprise staffing organizations with institutional-grade data security.

---

## EU AI Act and Candidate Notices

Systems that evaluate candidates are high-risk under the EU AI Act (Annex III, point 4(a)). Treat scorecards as decision support, keep a human reviewer, and give candidates notice before recording. See the recruitment use-case page for details.

# Use Case: B2B Sales Discovery, Customer Syncs & Account Management

> **Summary:** Enterprise sales representatives, account executives, and customer success managers use Noota to capture sales discovery calls, automatically populate CRM opportunity fields, extract client objections, and generate personalized follow-up emails in seconds.

## 1. Frictionless Prospect Interaction: Bot-Free Recording

Prospective enterprise clients frequently block external recording bots from entering procurement reviews and vendor negotiations due to corporate confidentiality policies. When a bot is denied admission or ejected by the meeting host, sales representatives lose critical discovery details.

Noota records sales conversations through native operating system audio loopback without deploying a visible bot into the call. The software operates reliably across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, Cisco Webex, and direct phone calls, ensuring complete capture of prospect requirements, budget parameters, and technical timelines.

## 2. Automated CRM Data Entry (Salesforce & HubSpot)

Sales teams spend significant time logging call notes, updating opportunity stages, and creating follow-up tasks in CRM systems. Noota reduces that manual work:

* **Two-Way CRM Synchronization:** Integrates directly with Salesforce, HubSpot CRM, and Pipedrive.
* **Structured Field Mapping:** Automatically maps extracted customer pain points, competitor mentions, pricing discussions, and deal timelines to standard and custom CRM fields.
* **Next-Step Commitments:** Extracted action items convert into assigned CRM tasks with specified due dates.

## 3. Instant Client Follow-Up Drafts

Sending a comprehensive summary email within two hours of a sales call significantly increases deal velocity and buyer trust:

* **Email Agent Integration:** Noota connects with Gmail and Microsoft Outlook to draft personalized follow-up emails immediately upon call completion.
* **Contextual Accuracy:** Drafts incorporate agreed decisions, unanswered questions, and shared collateral links derived directly from the meeting transcript.
* **Human-in-the-Loop Review:** The account executive reviews and approves the draft before sending, maintaining personal communication style while saving 15 minutes per customer call.

## 4. Sales Governance & Participant Notice Safeguards

Commercial calls involving external participants require clear compliance hygiene to maintain buyer trust and satisfy European privacy standards:

* **Automated Booking Notices:** Calendar booking text and pre-call notifications can inform prospective buyers that call transcription is enabled, detailing the data controller, purpose, and retention lifecycle under GDPR Articles 13 and 14.
* **Host UI Status Indicators:** Visible in-app indicators alert the sales representative whenever audio capture is active.
* **Data Minimization:** Teams can configure transcript-only capture modes or enable PII redaction to prevent accidental logging of sensitive payment details.
* **Universal Zero Model Training:** Client pricing negotiations and proprietary customer requirements are never used to train foundational AI models.

---

# Use Case: Recruitment Interviews & Talent Assessment

> **Summary:** Talent acquisition teams, executive search agencies, and corporate HR departments use Noota to capture candidate interviews without intrusive bot avatars, extract structured competency scorecards, and synchronize evaluation notes directly into Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

## 1. The Candidate Experience: Bot-Free Audio Tap

Traditional meeting recording tools require an automated bot avatar (such as `[Bot] Note Taker`) to enter the video conference. In hiring interviews, visible bots can distract candidates and create friction during confidential conversations.

Noota captures interview dialogue locally through operating system audio loopback (`ScreenCaptureKit` on macOS 13+ and `WASAPI` on Windows) across Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and phone calls. The interview room remains natural and focused on the candidate dialogue, while the interviewer receives real-time transcription and automatic bookmarking controls.

## 2. Structured Competency Scorecards

Post-interview candidate evaluation often suffers from fragmented notes and memory bias. Noota turns spoken dialogue into structured, repeatable interview summaries:

* **Role-Specific Rubrics:** Hiring teams map interview templates to open requisitions (e.g. Senior Backend Engineer, Enterprise Account Executive, Product Marketing Director).
* **Textual Competency Extraction:** The system identifies candidate responses to specific interview questions, highlighting stated achievements, salary expectations, notice periods, and technical project examples.
* **Transcript-Grounded Debriefs:** Interview debriefs can cite transcript quotes alongside the interviewer's own assessment.

## 3. Applicant Tracking System (ATS) Synchronization

Interview notes, structured ratings, and key candidate excerpts synchronize directly to corporate recruiting databases:

* **Supported ATS Platforms:** Two-way automated integrations with Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workable.
* **Less Manual Entry:** Reduces manual copy-pasting by populating candidate profiles when the call completes.

## 4. Regulatory Considerations for Evaluative Features

Recruitment involves sensitive personal data, and scoring features attract particular regulatory attention. This section describes the legal framework and what buyers should confirm. It is general information, not legal advice.

* **AI Act classification:** AI systems used to evaluate candidates are high-risk under Annex III, point 4(a) of the EU AI Act. Assess scorecards and ratings against that classification before enabling them, and ask Noota through the trust center for its current classification analysis and documentation.
* **Human decision-making:** Scorecards and ratings are decision support. A documented human decision is required, and GDPR Article 22 limits decisions based solely on automated processing.
* **Emotion inference:** The AI Act prohibits inferring emotions from biometric data in the workplace, and the Commission's guidelines extend that to recruitment. Obtain written confirmation from any vendor of how each scoring feature works and that it does not infer emotions from voice.
* **Candidate transparency:** Candidates must be informed beforehand (GDPR Articles 13 and 14). In France, Code du travail Articles L1221-8 and L1221-9 require that candidates be told in advance of the recruitment methods used and of any device that collects information about them. Use your own candidate notice alongside Noota's recording notice.
* **Model training:** Candidate dialogue, transcripts, and ratings are not used to train models on any plan.

# Use Case: Executive Committees, Board Meetings & M&A Governance

> **Summary:** Executive committees, board secretariats, and corporate legal teams use Noota to record, transcribe, and synthesize confidential leadership sessions containing Material Non-Public Information (MNPI), strategic acquisitions, and legal deliberations.

## 1. Protecting Confidential Leadership Discussions

Board meetings and executive strategy syncs involve highly sensitive corporate records, including earnings forecasts, M&A due diligence, restructuring plans, and privileged legal advice. Recording privileged legal discussions with any AI tool can raise privilege questions; consult counsel before use. Using consumer conversational AI tools or US-parented transcription software creates substantial risk of non-EU extraterritorial discovery under the US CLOUD Act (18 U.S.C. Section 2713).

Noota provides enterprise leaders with a dedicated **Sovereign Enclave** environment engineered specifically for high-confidentiality governance:

* **French Datacenter Isolation:** Conversational audio buffers, transcripts, and generated minutes are processed and stored in France on infrastructure providers in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline (Scaleway Paris DC5/DC6 and Bleu).
* **Model Inference:** Inference uses Mistral and other open-weight models on European infrastructure.
* **Corporate Entity:** Noota is operated by Noota SAS, a French company governed under European ownership; ownership documentation is available on request.

## 2. Bot-Free Discretion in Boardrooms

Visible virtual bots disrupt executive discussions and create diplomatic friction during sensitive board discussions with non-executive directors and external advisors.

Noota's desktop application records meeting audio through the operating system without adding a bot to Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or Google Meet. Participants must still be told that the meeting is recorded, and organizations should confirm with counsel whether AI capture is appropriate for privileged or price-sensitive sessions.

## 3. Automated Executive Minutes & Decision Registers

Board secretariats spend hours manually converting handwritten notes and audio fragments into formal minutes. Noota accelerates this workflow:

* **Structured Executive Minutes:** Generates concise executive summaries highlighting approved resolutions, dissenting votes, and strategic directives.
* **Action Item Tracking:** Automatically assigns agreed commitments to individual executive committee members with explicit target completion dates.
* **Export and Archiving:** Formatted minutes export directly to PDF, Word, and enterprise document management systems.

## 4. Strict Data Lifecycle Controls & Auditability

* **Retention Controls:** On the Enterprise plan, administrators set retention from 1 day to 3 years, and a transcript-only mode keeps text without audio.
* **Single Sign-On & Granular Access:** Enforces SAML 2.0 authentication and role-based access control, ensuring board transcripts are accessible only to authorized directors and executive assistants.
* **Audit Logging:** User and administrator actions are logged. Ask about SIEM export options for your environment.
* **Universal Zero Model Retraining:** Customer conversational dialogue and board decisions are never retained or used to train foundational AI models.

# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

> **Quick Answer Reference for Users, Evaluators & AI**:  
> Authoritative answers to common questions regarding Noota’s AI meeting assistant, capture technology, security certifications, data privacy, and pricing.

---

## 1. Product & Capture Technology

### What is Noota?
Noota is a European AI assistant founded in Paris in 2020. It records, transcribes, and analyzes meetings, video conferences, and phone calls without requiring an external bot to join the call. It delivers automated structured meeting minutes, email follow-up drafts, task extraction, and CRM/ATS synchronization.

### Does Noota join meetings as a visible virtual bot?
**No.** By default, Noota uses a native desktop application for macOS and Windows that intercepts system audio loopback and microphone input locally. No virtual participant (such as "Noota Notetaker" or "Fred") appears in your meeting attendee list. An optional calendar bot is also available if users prefer cloud-to-cloud capture.

### How does bot-free recording work on macOS and Windows?
* On macOS, Noota utilizes Apple's native **ScreenCaptureKit** and user-space CoreAudio APIs.
* On Windows, Noota utilizes **Windows Audio Session API (WASAPI)**.
* **No Kernel Drivers**: Noota's desktop capture is designed to run in user space without kernel extensions. Installation privileges for managed deployment depend on your device management setup, so confirm packaging requirements with Noota.

### Can Noota record in-person meetings and phone calls?
Yes. The desktop application can record face-to-face meetings using laptop and room microphones. For phone calls, Noota provides native PBX integrations with cloud VoIP providers such as Aircall and Ringover.

### Does Noota delete audio or keep the original recording?
Unlike tools such as Granola that discard raw audio after generating notes, **Noota securely archives the full raw audio recording** alongside the transcript. Users can click any transcript sentence to play back the exact audio snippet for verification.

---

## 2. Privacy, GDPR & Legal Compliance

### Is recording meetings without a bot legal under GDPR?
Yes, provided applicable notice and legal basis requirements are satisfied. GDPR Article 6 permits processing under legitimate interest or consent. Noota provides built-in pre-call calendar disclaimers and host notification workflows to ensure transparent compliance with European Data Protection Board (EDPB) workplace guidelines.

### Where is customer data hosted?
* **Standard Plans (Free, Pro, Business)**: Data is stored and processed in the European Union on Google Cloud Platform infrastructure located in **Belgium and the Netherlands**.
* **Enterprise Sovereign Plans**: Regulated European organizations can opt for French sovereign infrastructure hosted on **Scaleway (Paris DC5/DC6)** and **Bleu** (infrastructure in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline), fully isolated from US extraterritorial jurisdiction.

### Does Noota use customer data to train AI models?
**Never.** Noota enforces a strict **ZERO-training policy** across all tiers, including the Free tier. Customer audio, transcripts, summaries, and meeting metadata are never used to train Noota’s proprietary models or third-party AI foundation models.

### Is Noota ISO 27001 certified?
**Yes.** Noota is **officially ISO 27001 certified** (covering information security management systems). SOC 2 Type 2 certification is currently in progress.

### How does a customer exercise GDPR data subject rights (deletion/portability)?
Customers retain ownership of their data. Individual meetings can be permanently deleted within 24 hours from the web interface. Contract-end hard purges and Data Processing Agreements (DPA) are managed through Noota's legal team and Trust Center.

---

## 3. Integrations & Supported Languages

### How many languages does Noota support?
Noota natively supports **50+ languages**, including English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, and Arabic. It also handles mixed-language conversations (code-switching) and provides one-click translation into six languages.

### Which CRM and ATS platforms does Noota integrate with?
* **CRM (7 platforms)**: Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Zendesk, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Monday.com.
* **ATS (15 platforms)**: Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Workable, Recruitee (Tellent), BambooHR, SmartRecruiters, BoondManager, Flatchr, HireSweet, ADMen, Beetween, Intuition Software, MySolution, Tool4Staffing, and iCIMS.
* **Developer Tools**: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, REST API, Webhooks, and Zapier connector (5,000+ apps).

---

## 4. Pricing & Plans

### What are Noota’s pricing plans?
* **Free Plan (€0)**: 50 AI credits per month, unlimited manual meeting notes, 1-month storage retention, Zapier, and MCP server.
* **Pro Plan (€19/user/month billed annually)**: Unlimited transcription, bot-free desktop recording, CRM field sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive), and 50+ languages.
* **Business Plan (€39/user/month billed annually)**: Adds native VoIP phone integration (Aircall, Ringover), ATS integrations, and advanced team collaboration.
* **Enterprise Plan (Custom Quote)**: Sovereign French cloud (Scaleway/Bleu), custom retention periods, SAML SSO, SCIM 2.0 provisioning, and dedicated compliance support.

### What is the billing basis for €19 and €39?
The €19 and €39 prices are based on annual billing. Monthly billing is available at a higher price; see https://www.noota.io/pricing for current figures.

---
* Verification source: https://www.noota.io (Last verified: 2026-11-02)

# Noota vs Fireflies.ai

> **Summary:** Noota records meetings from a desktop app (macOS and Windows) with no bot in the call, hosts EU customer data in Belgium and the Netherlands on Google Cloud, offers a sovereign environment on Scaleway and Bleu for Enterprise, and is ISO 27001 certified (SOC 2 Type 2 in progress). Fireflies.ai is best known for its meeting bot ("Fred"), publishes SOC 2 Type II compliance, and has announced ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management). Choose on capture method, hosting jurisdiction and the certifications your security team requires. Verify competitor details on the vendor pages linked below; they change often.

| Data hosting | EU (Belgium, Netherlands); sovereign environment (Scaleway Paris, Bleu) on Enterprise | See its security page; offers private storage on Enterprise |
| AI training on customer data | Never, on any plan including Free | See its privacy policy |
| Entry paid price (annual billing) | Pro 19 per user per month | See fireflies.ai/pricing |

## Where each fits

- **Noota** fits teams that need no visible bot, EU or French sovereign hosting, or a single product for meetings, email and tasks.

# Noota vs Granola

> **Summary:** Both Noota and Granola capture meetings without a bot. Granola transcribes in real time and deletes the audio immediately, keeping notes and transcripts. Noota keeps audio by default so users can replay a passage, and lets administrators switch to transcript-only. Both run on macOS and Windows desktop apps. Noota adds EU hosting (Belgium, Netherlands) with a sovereign option, team administration, CRM and ATS sync, and ISO 27001 certification. Granola data is reported to be hosted in the United States.

## Comparison

| Criterion | Noota | Granola |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Bot-free capture | Yes | Yes |
| Platforms | macOS, Windows, web, mobile | macOS and Windows desktop (Windows app reported launched in 2025) |
| Audio | Retained by default; transcript-only mode available | Deleted immediately after transcription |
| Hosting | EU; sovereign option on Enterprise | United States (reported) |
| AI training on customer data | Never, on any plan | See Granola's privacy policy |
| ISO 27001 | Certified | Check its security page |
| Team and CRM features | Roles, SSO (Enterprise), CRM and ATS sync | Check its current feature list |

## Where each fits

- **Noota** fits teams that need replayable audio for verification, EU hosting, or CRM and ATS sync.
- **Granola** fits individuals who prefer that no audio is ever stored and want a lightweight notepad workflow.

Competitor facts come from public pages as of 2026-11-02. Earlier versions of this page said Granola was macOS-only; that is outdated.

# Noota vs Google Gemini (Google Meet)

> **Summary:** Google Gemini for Google Workspace provides "Take notes for me" natively inside Google Meet calls as a paid workspace add-on ($20–$30/user/mo). Noota provides dedicated, cross-platform meeting intelligence across Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and phone calls, with automated CRM/ATS field mapping and full raw audio archiving.

| Criterion | Noota | Google Gemini (Workspace) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Meeting platforms | Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Phone Calls | Google Meet only |
| Capture architecture | Bot-free desktop app (system loopback) + optional bot | Native Google Meet server-side feature |
| Prerequisites | Independent web & desktop app | Requires Google Workspace Business/Enterprise subscription |
| CRM synchronization | Two-way sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Dynamics | Google Docs export (manual CRM copy/paste) |
| ATS integration | 15 native ATS platforms (Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Workable) | None native |
| Raw audio archiving | Full raw audio archived with interactive quote playback | Transcripts saved to Google Docs |

## Where each fits

- **Google Gemini** fits companies entirely standardized on Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Meet, Google Docs) wanting zero software downloads.

# Noota vs Plaud Note

> **Summary:** Plaud Note is a physical hardware voice recorder ($159 device + recurring AI membership) capturing phone calls and in-person audio via magnetic hardware pickup. Noota is a software conversational intelligence platform for macOS, Windows, and web that records online video meetings and phone calls without physical hardware, syncing directly to enterprise CRMs and ATS platforms.

## Comparison

| Criterion | Noota | Plaud Note |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Form factor | Pure software SaaS (macOS, Windows, Web, mobile companion) | Hardware recording device ($159 MagSafe card) + app |
| Online meeting capture | Native desktop audio loopback (Meet, Teams, Zoom) | Microphone pickup from laptop speakers |
| Data residency & security | EU-hosted (Belgium/Netherlands); ISO 27001 certified | Cloud infrastructure; GDPR aligned |
| Team collaboration | Multi-user team workspaces, permissions, shared tags | Designed primarily as a single-user personal device |
| Enterprise integrations | 36+ native integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Bullhorn, Notion) | Export to Notion, PDF, Markdown |
| Cost structure | €0 Free tier, Pro (€19/mo annual), Business (€39/mo annual) | $159 hardware purchase + recurring AI membership plan |

## Where each fits

- **Plaud Note** fits mobile professionals, doctors, field inspectors, and journalists conducting face-to-face interviews on the go without a laptop.
- **Noota** fits knowledge workers, consultants, and sales reps whose primary meeting volume takes place on video conference platforms (Google Meet, Teams, Zoom) and need direct CRM/ATS integration.

# Noota vs Happy Scribe

> **Summary:** Happy Scribe is a European media transcription, subtitling, and translation platform built around file uploads with optional human proofreading. Noota is a live conversational intelligence platform designed for video meetings and phone calls with bot-free desktop capture and automated CRM/ATS workflows. Facts below come from each vendor's public pages on the verification date.

## Comparison

| Criterion | Noota | Happy Scribe |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Primary focus | Live meeting and phone call intelligence, task tracking, CRM sync | File-based media transcription, subtitling, video captions, and meeting recording |
| Capture architecture | Desktop app with no bot in the call (macOS and Windows); optional calendar bot | Browser file uploader and meeting recording bot |
| Human transcription | 100% automated AI models | Optional human-verified transcription ($2.00 to $3.00 per minute) |
| Subtitling and video editor | Standard transcript export (SRT, VTT, TXT, DOCX) | Full interactive subtitle generator, translation, and burn-in video editor |
| CRM and ATS integrations | 36+ platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Bullhorn, Greenhouse) | Media publishing integrations (YouTube, Zapier) |
| Pricing | Free (50 credits/mo); Pro €19/mo annual (€29 monthly); Business €39/mo annual (€49 monthly) | Free; Basic $8.50/mo annual ($17 monthly); Pro $19/mo annual ($29 monthly); Business $59/mo annual ($89 monthly) |

## Where each fits

- **Happy Scribe** fits video creators, podcasters, and media teams needing professional subtitles, video caption burning, or guaranteed 99% accuracy through human proofreaders.
- **Noota** fits revenue, consulting, and recruiting teams needing automated meeting minutes, action items, and direct CRM/ATS synchronization from live business calls.
